_note: SYNTHETIC, AUTHOR-LABELED. Every milestone, criterion and submission below was written by the author for this evaluation; none is real client work. Gold labels were written BEFORE running either engine and committed before the first eval run. Criterion-level gold labels: 'met' = the submission contains concrete, checkable evidence for the criterion; 'not_met' = the submission shows the criterion is not (fully) satisfied (partial delivery, wrong format, number below threshold, explicit contradiction); 'insufficient_evidence' = the criterion is merely asserted, or not addressed at all, so it cannot be verified from the submission. Milestone-level gold decision is derived mechanically: approve if every criterion is met; else reject if any criterion is not_met; else needs_review.
